[@sakaladev/usai](/docs/sdk/) / [index](/docs/sdk/index/) / AuthDeclaration



What `auth.bearer`/`auth.header`/`auth.custom` return: a named
boundary reused by reference. `Principal` is the type of `ctx.auth`.
